senses.gloss_en: trailer (towed behind a truck or tractor)

senses.gloss_en: mainstay; pillar (of a country, family or organisation)

examples.en: Young people are the mainstay of the nation.

senses.gloss_en: cool; refreshing (only in compounds such as mát rượi)

examples.vi: Gió thổi mát rượi trên bờ sông.
examples.en: The breeze felt pleasantly cool by the river.

senses.gloss_en: very; deeply (after a feeling word, as in buồn rượi)

senses.gloss_en: to be in heat; to rut

senses.gloss_en: to chase; to run after and try to catch

examples.vi: Con chó rượt bắt con gà khắp sân.
examples.en: The dog chased the chicken all around the yard.

senses.gloss_en: black glutinous rice wine (a sweet purple-red drink from northern Vietnam)

examples.vi: Ở Sa Pa, chúng tôi được uống rượu cẩm của người dân tộc.
examples.en: In Sa Pa, we got to drink black rice wine made by the local people.

notes: Wiktionary says 'distilled liquor'; as I know it rượu cẩm is a sweet fermented black glutinous rice drink, so the gloss avoids 'distilled'. Please verify.

examples.vi: Cô ấy thích uống rượu cốctay hơn bia.

senses.gloss_en: to be forced to do something after refusing a polite request (literally 'refuse the offered wine, get the penalty wine')

senses.gloss_en: glutinous rice wine; sweet fermented glutinous rice (a northern dish)

examples.en: On the morning of the Double Fifth festival, the family eats sweet fermented glutinous rice to kill off pests.

senses.gloss_en: moonshine; home-distilled rice liquor (same as rượu đế)

senses.gloss_en: to be worn out; to be dead tired

senses.gloss_en: small crab (a brackish-water crab used in cooking)
